content.short: NFT monster battle game that runs entirely inside a Uniswap v4 hook on Unichain.
content.description: Unimon was the first game built inside a Uniswap v4 hook. Players swap ETH into its UMN pool to receive eggs, hatch them into monsters, level them up with items and equipment, and battle until a final group splits an ETH prize pool, with 40 ETH on offer in one season. Its contracts are open source, and Season 3 is on the way.
content.meta: Hatch, level and battle NFT monsters for ETH prizes in Unimon, a game built inside a Uniswap v4 hook on Unichain.
